consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1992-02-22 show at Oakland Coliseum featured some solid performances, particularly highlighting the debut of 'So Many Roads.' While some reviewers found the overall show to be mediocre, others appreciated the energy and fun atmosphere of the night.
